reasons.plausibility: Chromium coatings can form stable Cr–Al intermetallics that slow molten-aluminum attack, which is scientifically credible for boride-based substrates.
reasons.testability: The proposed controlled coating and side-by-side corrosion tests with measurable outcomes provide a clear route to falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: If validated, it offers a practical and impactful solution to improve molten-aluminum corrosion resistance in industrial settings.
